Evidence / CLM-003
Evidence record
When was it measured or observed?Mar-2025–Jan-2026

POS infrastructure expanded

01What does this evidence establish?

POS terminals reported by the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) rose from 561 in March 2025 to 1,473 in January 2026, within CBY-Aden's reporting scope. The December 2025 total of 1,357 and the January 2026 total of 1,473 imply growth of 8.55%, while the January source graphic displays +11%; both are shown, and the difference is recorded as an inconsistency within the source.

01What does this evidence establish?02What does it measure?03Who or what does it apply to?04How current is it?05What this evidence does not establish06Original source and verification07Method and verification detail

02What does it measure?

The monthly number of point-of-sale (POS) terminals reported by the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) within its reporting scope, March 2025 to January 2026.

03Who or what does it apply to?

POS terminals within the payment-system reporting scope of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden); how far that scope covers each area of Yemen is not established.

04How current is it?

The latest observation in this record refers to January 2026; the series runs monthly from March 2025. January 2026 was the latest monthly POS release on the payments page of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) when checked on 26 September 2026. The figures should not be read as describing a later period unless a newer comparable release is published.

05What this evidence does not establish

Growth in terminal numbers is not an inclusion rate, and it does not show merchant adoption or growth in unique users. The totals fall within the reporting scope of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) and are not shown to be national totals. The terminal series also contains a smaller source-internal percentage mismatch in June 2025, and the January 2026 release shows material discrepancies between its displayed growth percentages and the raw terminal and transaction totals. The September 2025 gap applies to the YER transaction-value series, not to the terminal count.

07Method and verification detail

Detail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

Monthly terminal totals as published in the monthly POS releases of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden). The 8.55% change is derived by this resource: the January 2026 total (1,473) divided by the December 2025 total (1,357), minus one. It is shown beside the +11% displayed in the January release rather than replacing it.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?

This record is drawn from the source(s) listed on this page. Open a source record to reach the original document, and check that the definition, period, population and geography match what is stated here.

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page. Before reusing or comparing it, check the source, limitations, evidence date and correction history. If a value or source link is unavailable, the page says so rather than filling the gap by inference. This resource does not host source files; where an original-source link is given, check the publisher’s terms before republishing.
